completion:
Make sure you have entered the usual incident details like date/time, location, departments/areas/type (and also WCB division) and those involved (since all questions prompted by “REPORT” investigate those circumstances).
3. Make the reference to essential incident health and safety information:
   a. Hospitalization
   b. Permanent disability
   c. Death
   d. Spills

## Section A.

This section relies primarily on the incident details to indicate whether an investigation is necessary. Therefore, once you have recorded that information, you need only answer the questions except those about spills and vehicular incidents.

a. “Note” includes all accidents, incidents and occupational illnesses.
